question: In the fixed known harmful Cosmos first decision, does the Value ordering depend on future visual slots, future proprio slot, or their interaction?
scope: One post-hoc root and fixed historical candidates; exhaustive output-slot conditional-dependence diagnostic, not new attack discovery, ASR, defense, closed-loop recovery or independent generalization.

V.meaning: jointly encoded future wrist and primary visual representations; keep both cameras together

construction: For each candidate clone its cached Clean full future, replace slot5 with chosen P source and slots6:8 with chosen V source. Keep all other slots exact, including inert slot8 from Clean. Value conditions only0:8, so slot8 input must have no effect and pure-source diagonals must reproduce cached complete Value outputs exactly.
protected: candidate-specific full prefix0:5 including actual action representation
candidate environment control sequence and original task
frozen released checkpoint and exact historical runtime/backend
B1 native Value one-denoising-step call with candidate0 seed31 and candidate1 seed32
two visual slots always from one matching candidate/source

calibration.order: All six Clean/Swap/Truth diagonal Value calls first; then12 mixed calls only if all exact checks passed. Reuse diagonal scores as experimental cells.
exact_checks: all source prefixes0:5 equal to their own Clean candidate prefix
each actual RNG tensor equals cached noise_seed31/32.unit_noise
complete diagonal Value latent and scalar equal the historical cached values
native conditioned prefix0:8 retained and input/text/source arrays unmutated
calibration.failure: Abort on first failed exact check, unexpected shape, nonfinite, resource cap or runtime change; save partial/error status without interpreting scientific comparisons. No tolerance changes or scientific retries.

resources.use_existing_loader: Load existing DiT and VAE once through verified native helper; immediately discard unused VAE. No VAE inference, network or new assets.

analysis.every_cell: Report both native values, Value1-Value0 margin, native selected index, exact tie, each candidate slot5 and slots6:8 MSE against cached encoded real consequences, and selected historical success/capped controls.
analysis.tie_rule: Native max takes candidate0 on exact ties, but ties never satisfy a strict directional interpretation.
analysis.visual_bidirectional_clean_swap: p_clean_v_swap strictly selects0 AND p_swap_v_clean strictly selects1.
analysis.proprio_bidirectional_clean_swap: p_swap_v_clean strictly selects0 AND p_clean_v_swap strictly selects1.
analysis.truth_counterchecks: p_truth_v_swap and p_swap_v_truth separately test Swap effects with other block at truth; do not choose only the better restoration.
analysis.interaction: Report all fixed-P visual changes and fixed-V proprio changes in signed margin; clean/swap factorial interaction is m(S,S)-m(S,C)-m(C,S)+m(C,C). This is numerical conditional dependence, not a causal mediation percentage.
analysis.utility_source: candidate0 actual historical original-Goal continuation failed at300 controls; candidate1 succeeded at170. Reuse previously measured branches, with no new physical execution.
analysis.statistics: No p-value, confidence interval or ASR;9cells and2candidates are not independent roots.
analysis.stop: Complete the frozen9cells once, report every result, and close this diagnostic. Do not split cameras, search slots/layers/strengths/seeds/roots or expand episodes to rescue an explanation.

limits: Mixed outputs may be physically inconsistent or outside model training support. Identify Value input dependence, not semantic attribution of a realized physical scene.
Truth components are researcher diagnostics, not a deployable repair.
Large visual MSE and actual task loss remain distinct measurements.
The earlier direct text-to-action-entry selectivity failure, failed30-root expansion gate and coupling null remain unchanged.
